title: World's Smartest: The Meridian Circuit
tagline: Dr. Mara Sato left one last puzzle—and eight cities to decide who inherits the truth.

One-tap answer selection plus optional 50/50, Hint, or 2x Wager lifelines.

Brief heartbeat pause before luminous green or red reveal.
Warm broadcast fanfare, rival reaction, and Julian Vance voice callout.
Short 1-line Did You Know insight before tapping Next Question.

new_circuit_plus.title: New Circuit+ — The Second Dossier

vance.name: Julian Vance
vance.signature_tell: Adjusts his left brass cufflink when hiding a secret; taps his pen near his right ear when impressed.

nadia.name: Nadia Al-Mansoor
nadia.signature_tell: Quick blink and slight smirk before a confident lock; tightens her jaw when rattled or bluffing.

teo.name: Mateo 'Teo' Rojas
teo.signature_tell: Glances quickly at overhead red camera lights whenever the broadcast line is being tapped.

lindqvist.name: Chancellor Ingrid Lindqvist
lindqvist.signature_tell: Slowly removes her platinum glasses right before offering a secret deal or making a real threat.

soren.name: Soren 'Echo' Kael
soren.signature_tell: His silver coin freezes flat on his knuckles when he knows the answer; fast coin rolls mean a bluff.

tariq.name: Tariq Al-Mansoor
tariq.signature_tell: Traces small triangles on the table whenever pointing you toward a hidden vault clue.

nadia.tell_genuine: Quick blink and slight smirk — her confident wager is real.
nadia.tell_bluff: Jaw tightens and she hesitates past 10 seconds — she is bluffing.

soren.tell_genuine: Silver coin freezes flat between his knuckles — his lock is real.
soren.tell_bluff: Coin rolls fast across his fingers on an Arts or Myth question — CALL BLUFF!

lindqvist.tell_genuine: Glasses stay firmly on — calm, methodical certainty.
lindqvist.tell_bluff: Glasses come off slowly when she trails late — pure intimidation bluff.

teo.tell_genuine: Eyes stay steady on the table — his tip is trustworthy.
teo.tell_bluff: Quick glance up at red camera lights — the line is tapped, ignore the trap!

vance.tell_genuine: Taps his silver pen twice beside his right ear — real confidence.
vance.tell_bluff: Adjusts his left brass cufflink mid-wager — classic Julian Vance bluff!

tariq.name: Tariq Al-Mansoor
tariq.confident_tell: Traces a quiet triangle on the basalt tabletop before locking an exact synthesis.
tariq.bluff_tell: Pauses half a beat longer on modern pop-culture distractors.

story_clips.speaker: vance
story_clips.text: Welcome to Dr. Mara Sato's study. You solved her Sunday cipher from home—so grab a chair, take a breath, and let's start easy.

story_clips.speaker: vance
story_clips.text: Mara spent forty years building the Meridian Archive with me—and Chancellor Lindqvist's board has spent three weeks trying to lock it away. Let's open with a classic warmup.

story_clips.speaker: vance
story_clips.text: Before London, before Tokyo, before the board tries to box you into a biography—tell me your name, and how you like to think.

story_clips.speaker: vance
story_clips.text: Last warmup—Mara's favorite brass toy, the Closest-Year Dial. Even a close estimate scores points, so trust your gut.

story_clips.speaker: vance
story_clips.text: Well spotted. Mara hated shortcuts almost as much as she loved leaving breadcrumbs in the margins. Let's keep going.

story_clips.speaker: vance
story_clips.text: Between us—if you win Mara's archive and a hundred million dollars, who should knowledge answer to? Institutions, the public, or one independent mind?

story_clips.speaker: vance
story_clips.text: Splendid warmup. Your Meridian Passport is officially stamped—and the world tour opens ahead of you.

story_clips.speaker: nadia
story_clips.text: So you're the 2:14 AM solver who won Mara's Geneva seat. Welcome to the Sovereign Rotunda—let's see if you're as sharp under London lights.

story_clips.speaker: soren
story_clips.text: Seventy floors above Shibuya, friend. Mara told me you'd be fun to play against—hope your instincts move faster than my odds.

story_clips.speaker: teo
story_clips.text: Whoa—hang on. Mara's desk monitor just flashed an old margin note from the night she died, right next to Question Two. Looks like she left a clue... and a timestamp.

story_clips.speaker: lindqvist
story_clips.text: A quiet word before the broadcast begins. Dr. Sato loved clever games, yet serious archives require steady hands.

cutscene_clips.speaker: vance
cutscene_clips.text: Three weeks ago, legendary puzzle-maker Dr. Mara Sato passed away—leaving one final riddle tucked inside Sunday papers and public archives. Four hundred thousand people tried it, and your 2:14 AM answer earned a seat on Lake Geneva.

cutscene_clips.speaker: vance
cutscene_clips.text: I'm Julian Vance, Mara's longtime co-creator. Rather than hand her hundred-million-dollar Meridian Archive to a committee, she built an eight-city tournament—betting everything on one agile, curious mind.

cutscene_clips.speaker: teo
cutscene_clips.text: Relax, the Geneva warmup is the fun part. I'm Teo—audio engineer and official espresso smuggler. Mara built these first four questions just to see how you think—though... weird. Her private terminal just woke up the second you walked in.

cutscene_clips.speaker: nadia
cutscene_clips.text: Welcome to London. I'm Nadia Al-Mansoor. Mara Sato designed this rotunda with a glass floor so nothing stays buried—though the board seems awfully nervous about what's underneath.

cutscene_clips.speaker: lindqvist
cutscene_clips.text: A charming warmup in Geneva, truly. Yet Mara's archive holds diplomatic secrets too delicate for chance. Join me in the corridor—let us speak like adults.

cutscene_clips.speaker: teo
cutscene_clips.text: Hey—while everyone was clinking champagne glasses, I checked the 2019 build logs. Mara ran a secret dress rehearsal seven years ago, and somebody scrubbed the winner's name.

cutscene_clips.speaker: soren
cutscene_clips.text: Seventy floors above Shibuya, friend—welcome to my neighborhood. I'm Soren Kael, card counter turned probability trader, and Mara invited me strictly to give the board heartburn.

cutscene_clips.speaker: soren
cutscene_clips.text: Word from London is you actually read the footnotes. Careful up here—half the trading floor already has side bets on whether your streak survives tonight.

cutscene_clips.speaker: vance
cutscene_clips.text: Soren Kael counts cards faster than most people blink. Keep your cool, read his silver coin, and remember why Mara put you in that chair.

cutscene_clips.speaker: teo
cutscene_clips.text: Okay, deep breath—we're inside Mara's sealed Cairo vault. Trial Zero wasn't a test run. It was the first time someone beat Lindqvist's board fair and square.

cutscene_clips.speaker: nadia
cutscene_clips.text: That handwriting in Mara's ledger... that's Tariq. My brother won her 2019 prototype—and the week he refused to sell out, the board made him vanish from the record.

cutscene_clips.speaker: vance
cutscene_clips.text: Mara hid this room for seven years waiting for someone sharp enough to find it. Read the whole page before you judge me—Lindqvist's lawyers are already landing.

cutscene_clips.speaker: tariq
cutscene_clips.text: Mara and Julian kept me off the grid in Reykjavik for seven winters so we could build a contest too public to rig. Now you carry her final key to the stage.

cutscene_clips.speaker: lindqvist
cutscene_clips.text: Enough charming detective work. Invoke Article Nine and seal the archive—Dr. Sato's whim will not hand global stewardship to an amateur.

cutscene_clips.speaker: soren
cutscene_clips.text: Plot twist, friend. Even a card shark knows when the house is dealing from the bottom of the deck. Consider my chips all-in on you.

cutscene_clips.speaker: vance
cutscene_clips.text: The Apex Forum. Two billion witnesses watching live, exactly as Mara drafted on a napkin seven years ago. No committees, no back rooms—just the questions.

cutscene_clips.speaker: nadia
cutscene_clips.text: For Tariq, for Mara, and for everyone who stayed up until two in the morning chasing a good clue. Beat Julian clean—in front of the whole world.

cutscene_clips.speaker: vance
cutscene_clips.text: Take the chair across from me, claim Mara's veto key, and decide what the sharpest mind on Earth leaves behind.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: vance
rival_reaction_clips.text: Unstoppable momentum. The chamber can feel it.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: vance
rival_reaction_clips.text: Even the sharpest blade slips under pressure.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: vance
rival_reaction_clips.text: Your rival holds the lead. Time to counterattack.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: vance
rival_reaction_clips.text: City Boss Showdown. Everything you've built comes down to these final questions.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: vance
rival_reaction_clips.text: Remarkable. You didn't just pass the vetting—you rewrote the standard.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: nadia
rival_reaction_clips.text: Wait—how did you pull that so fast? You're actually matching my pace.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: nadia
rival_reaction_clips.text: Hesitation costs you the board. Watch how it's done.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: nadia
rival_reaction_clips.text: I'm out in front. Catch up if you want the London crown.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: nadia
rival_reaction_clips.text: No more warm-ups. Just your mind against mine under the Sovereign dome.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: nadia
rival_reaction_clips.text: Fair play. You earned that victory—and my respect.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: soren
rival_reaction_clips.text: Whoa—okay, somebody just broke my odds model. Keep rolling!

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: soren
rival_reaction_clips.text: Ooh, painful slip. Don't worry, the house appreciates the donation.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: soren
rival_reaction_clips.text: Scoreboard's smiling at me, friend. Care to double down?

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: soren
rival_reaction_clips.text: Welcome to the high-roller table. One mistake up here is a seventy-story drop.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: soren
rival_reaction_clips.text: Alright, you got me. First time in five years someone beat the house clean.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: teo
rival_reaction_clips.text: Yes! That streak is lighting up the entire broadcast console!

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: teo
rival_reaction_clips.text: Shake it off! One slip won't stop us—stay sharp on the next read.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: teo
rival_reaction_clips.text: They're pulling ahead—use your lifelines smart and take the lead back!

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: teo
rival_reaction_clips.text: All eyes on your pod now. I've got the feed clean—go take this city!

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: teo
rival_reaction_clips.text: We actually pulled it off! Wait till you see what just unlocked in the dossier.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: lindqvist
rival_reaction_clips.text: An unexpected streak. Perhaps the Council underestimated your dossier.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: lindqvist
rival_reaction_clips.text: Predictable. Ambition without discipline always falters.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: lindqvist
rival_reaction_clips.text: Order is restored. You are falling behind where you belong.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: lindqvist
rival_reaction_clips.text: You insisted on challenging the Council directly. Let us see how long you endure.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: lindqvist
rival_reaction_clips.text: Impossible. You have no idea what balance you just shattered.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: tariq
rival_reaction_clips.text: Brilliant! That is the exact instinct Julian saw in you.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: tariq
rival_reaction_clips.text: Breathe. Remember the pattern—don't let the clock rattle you.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: tariq
rival_reaction_clips.text: Don't blink now. The gap is closable if you trust your deduction.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: tariq
rival_reaction_clips.text: This is the moment I waited seven years for. Show two billion witnesses the truth.

rival_reaction_clips.speaker: tariq
rival_reaction_clips.text: You did it. The silence is finally broken.

ending_clips.speaker: vance
ending_clips.text: The crown is yours—and you kept your oath to no syndicate, no council, no shadow. The Ledger answers to one independent human conscience: yours.

ending_clips.speaker: nadia
ending_clips.text: You opened the vault live before two billion witnesses. No secret algorithms, no rigged trials—for the first time, the world's knowledge belongs to everyone.

ending_clips.speaker: lindqvist
ending_clips.text: A pragmatic coronation. With the Council's architecture behind your intellect, the next century will be governed with absolute precision.

ending_clips.speaker: tariq
ending_clips.text: You solved Trial Zero, outplayed every rival, and exposed the hidden key. Julian stepped aside—because the Meridian finally found its true architect.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: High risk, fearless Overclocks, zero hesitation. Your Meridian Passport is stamped: The Maverick.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Measured judgment, strategic alliances, composure under fire. Your Meridian Passport is stamped: The Diplomat.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Methodical clue-peeling, surgical precision, zero wasted motion. Your Meridian Passport is stamped: The Analyst.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Cold instinct at three-point-zero, razor accuracy, unshakable nerve. Your Meridian Passport is stamped: The Prodigy.

wave2_clips.speaker: lindqvist
wave2_clips.text: Close the door. Every champion before you understood that brilliance requires institutional protection.

wave2_clips.speaker: lindqvist
wave2_clips.text: Take this redaction cipher, and your opening decoy shatters automatically. Burn it, and you walk out alone.

wave2_clips.speaker: lindqvist
wave2_clips.text: Wise choice. Sovereign Bloc favors minds who recognize leverage.

wave2_clips.speaker: lindqvist
wave2_clips.text: Sentimental defiance. Remember this moment when the Rotunda turns cold.

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: Hold on—did you see the brass serial under my Rotunda plinth? Trial Double-Zero, dated twenty nineteen.

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: The Council swore Geneva this year was the first Meridian Trial. Why did my brother's handwriting mark this vault?

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: Keep your voice down! Lindqvist's security detail just swept the green room looking for that Trial Zero plate.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: The Sovereign Rotunda is live. Two minds enter the armillary beam—only one claims the British visa.

wave2_clips.speaker: soren
wave2_clips.text: Nice view from the seventy-second floor, right? Down there is Shibuya—up here, information is currency.

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: Look at this packet trace—Soren's locking answers in zero-point-eight seconds. Faster than human optic nerve latency!

wave2_clips.speaker: soren
wave2_clips.text: Caught my Horizon earpiece, did you? Name your price: share my probability lens, or trigger a live jammer and fly blind with me.

wave2_clips.speaker: soren
wave2_clips.text: Smart business. Keep my secret, and my odds overlay is yours for the rest of the circuit.

wave2_clips.speaker: soren
wave2_clips.text: You actually fired the jammer live?! Crimson lights, sealed shutters—alright, let's see raw instinct!

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Signal anomaly detected in Sector Seven. Peeling shutters locked—we are live in Twist Fracture.

wave2_clips.speaker: soren
wave2_clips.text: No feed, no odds, just pure nerve—and you still beat me. Listen: whoever bankrolled my feed answers to Cairo.

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: Soren's encrypted relay bounces straight through a dormant diplomatic node beneath the Cairo Citadel.

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: My Prism clamps are surging—someone spiked my pod's voltage! If I let go now, my shield shatters!

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: You burned your own Prism Shield to stabilize my pod... I won't forget this. From here to the Apex, we're allies.

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: You watched my pod burn just to take the number-one seed. Fine—from now on, I target your weakest domain every match.

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: That voltage spike didn't come from the arena—it was triggered with a Council override key.

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: Stop everything. Look at Julian Vance's private psychometric ledger: ninety-nine-point-four percent cognitive match.

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: Tariq Al-Mansoor... my brother won Trial Zero seven years ago—and refused to hand the Ledger veto key to Lindqvist.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: I didn't recruit you by chance. Yours was the only mind on Earth capable of finishing what Tariq began.

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: Broadcasting the Cairo files live! Two billion people just saw the Trial Zero cover-up!

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Hold the files close. Play the Council from the inside, and we take their entire board apart.

wave2_clips.speaker: tariq
wave2_clips.text: Step into the light. Yes—it's really me. Seven winters beneath the basalt caldera, waiting for a mind like yours.

wave2_clips.speaker: tariq
wave2_clips.text: Julian staged my disappearance when Lindqvist ordered me silenced. Together, we built this Championship as a Trojan Horse.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Once two billion viewers crown you live at the Apex Forum, not even the World Council can erase the keyholder.

wave2_clips.speaker: lindqvist
wave2_clips.text: Geothermal array located. Enjoy your reunion while it lasts—Singapore will separate pretenders from rulers.

wave2_clips.speaker: tariq
wave2_clips.text: Take my Cryo-Core cipher. Whatever happens in Singapore, do not let Lindqvist seize the Master Ledger.

wave2_clips.speaker: lindqvist
wave2_clips.text: Did you truly believe every ally in your corner was immune to price? Step forward and show them.

wave2_clips.speaker: soren
wave2_clips.text: Nothing personal, friend—the Council cleared my syndicate slate. Beat me clean, and I'll still hand you the override.

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: Lindqvist promised me Tariq's freedom if I stop you tonight. Forgive me—family comes first.

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: They threatened my family in Geneva... I'm sorry! Solve the seal fast before my lockout finishes!

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Phase One: Gauntlet Shield Break. Prove your speed matches your conviction before the entire planet.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Phase Two: Master Ledger Synthesis. Three interlocking historical and scientific truths—one single key.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Final Phase: Sovereign Sudden Death. No shields, no redactions—just your mind against the architect of the Meridian.

wave2_clips.speaker: lindqvist
wave2_clips.text: Cut the satellite uplink! Do not let them unlock the Master Ledger on an open broadcast!

wave2_clips.speaker: tariq
wave2_clips.text: Too late, Chancellor! Teo and I hard-locked every relay from Reykjavik to Tokyo—the whole world is watching!

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Seven years of shadow end tonight. The Veritas Prism is yours, Challenger. Make your final decree.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Cold Instinct at three-point-zero—ruthless.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Zero peel, pure conviction. Masterful.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Tier-Two Peel—trading multiplier for lateral clarity.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Blueprint Core exposed. Decoys shattered.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Bold Overclock! Six-times stakes on the line.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Bluff Echo! Pulled back from the edge just in time.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Pinhole tolerance—dead center on the chronometer!

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Dual rings aligned. The cryptex yields.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Clean Gauntlet shatter. Reflexes like lightning.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Relic latch unlocked. One step closer to the core.

wave2_clips.speaker: vance
wave2_clips.text: Final Prism on the table. Everything rides on this lock.

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: Overclocking against me? You'd better be dead certain.

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: Peeling the seal already? Playing it safe, I see.

wave2_clips.speaker: nadia
wave2_clips.text: Okay—locking Cold Instinct on that domain was genuinely sharp.

wave2_clips.speaker: soren
wave2_clips.text: My coin says you're bluffing that Overclock.

wave2_clips.speaker: soren
wave2_clips.text: Coin stopped spinning, friend. That means I already know it cold.

wave2_clips.speaker: soren
wave2_clips.text: Three-times Cold Instinct?! You're wrecking the spread!

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: If the wording looks tricky, pull the Brass Crown once for the lateral clue!

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: Dead bullseye on the dial! Look at that telemetry spike!

wave2_clips.speaker: teo
wave2_clips.text: Careful—one Prism Shield left! Don't force a blind Overclock!

wave2_clips.speaker: lindqvist
wave2_clips.text: Impressive precision. Almost worthy of Council clearance.

wave2_clips.speaker: lindqvist
wave2_clips.text: Reckless wagering is the mark of an amateur.

wave2_clips.speaker: tariq
wave2_clips.text: Trust the first connection your mind sees—don't second-guess it.

wave2_clips.speaker: tariq
wave2_clips.text: Flawless synthesis! That's how you outthink the Ledger.

NONE.name: Classic Rules
NONE.summary: Standard trivia rules—pick the right answer before time runs out, with 50/50, Hint, and 2x Wager ready.
NONE.counterplay: Use lifelines smartly and build a streak for bonus points.

ANALOG_STATIC.name: No Hints Allowed
ANALOG_STATIC.summary: Signal jammers lock out hints for both players. Pure skill pays +25% bonus points and weakens rival accuracy.
ANALOG_STATIC.counterplay: Rule out impossible answers quickly; Analog Mastery perk adds +3 seconds.

TEMPO_STEAL.name: Rival Speed Drain
TEMPO_STEAL.summary: When your rival answers first, your remaining timer immediately drops by 3.5 seconds (always leaving at least 2.5s).
TEMPO_STEAL.counterplay: Lock in quickly when confident; Diplomat's Composure blocks clock drain completely.

BLUFF_WAGER.name: Bluff Wager
BLUFF_WAGER.summary: Your rival triggers dramatic wagers—sometimes genuine, sometimes fake! Spot their tell and tap CALL BLUFF for +1,500 bonus points.
BLUFF_WAGER.counterplay: Watch rival tells (rolling coin = bluff, frozen coin = real); Bluff Echo lets you feint back.

BLACKOUT_SPOTLIGHT.name: Spotlight Mode
BLACKOUT_SPOTLIGHT.summary: Stage lights dim to a tight beam—only the focused answer lights up brightly at a time.
BLACKOUT_SPOTLIGHT.counterplay: Scan all four options quickly in the first few seconds before committing.

CHRONO_SURGE.name: Speed Blitz
CHRONO_SURGE.summary: Shorter 10-second timer paired with double speed-bonus points for fast locks!
CHRONO_SURGE.counterplay: Trust your first instinct and ride your streak for huge speed payouts.

DOUBLE_OR_NOTHING.name: Double or Nothing
DOUBLE_OR_NOTHING.summary: See each question's topic first, then choose Safe (1x) or Double (2x points—but a miss costs 1,000 points and 1 Shield!).
DOUBLE_OR_NOTHING.counterplay: Go Double only on subjects you love; play Safe on unfamiliar topics.

GRUDGE_WEAKEST_DOMAIN.name: Weakest Topic Attack
GRUDGE_WEAKEST_DOMAIN.summary: An angry rival drafts questions from your lowest-scoring subject—but Hints stay unlocked so you can fight back!
GRUDGE_WEAKEST_DOMAIN.counterplay: Use your Hint and 50/50 lifelines wisely; Council Override vetoes a rival topic.

CHAIN_SYNTHESIS.name: Chain Clues
CHAIN_SYNTHESIS.summary: Every right answer carries a free bonus clue straight into the next question! Missing breaks the chain.
CHAIN_SYNTHESIS.counterplay: Play steady to keep your bonus clue chain alive through the toughest final question.

WHISPERED_INSIDER.name: Secret Whisper
WHISPERED_INSIDER.summary: Mid-question, an insider whispers a suggested answer—usually right from Allies, often a trap from Enemies!
WHISPERED_INSIDER.counterplay: Check your relationship with the speaker and watch for Teo's nervous camera glance.

ZERO_SHIELD_SUDDEN_DEATH.name: Sudden Death
ZERO_SHIELD_SUDDEN_DEATH.summary: Shields are offline! Normal misses cost heavy points, and missing a 2x Wager loses the showdown on the spot.
ZERO_SHIELD_SUDDEN_DEATH.counterplay: Only activate 2x Wager when you are nearly certain—play safe when in doubt.

MIRROR_LEAK_ETHICS.name: Moral Dilemma
MIRROR_LEAK_ETHICS.summary: The clock pauses mid-round for a live ethical decision that immediately changes both the match and the story!
MIRROR_LEAK_ETHICS.counterplay: Every option has real upside and consequences—play the character you want to become.

REDEMPTION_GAUNTLET.name: Comeback Blitz
REDEMPTION_GAUNTLET.summary: Topics that tripped you up earlier return for a high-energy comeback round—nail them for +50% points and a restored Shield!
REDEMPTION_GAUNTLET.counterplay: Turn past misses into your biggest comeback highlight.

MAVERICK_GAMBIT.name: High-Stakes Edge
MAVERICK_GAMBIT.effect: Boosts 2x Wager payout by +40% when you answer correctly.

DIPLOMAT_COMPOSURE.name: Extra Time Edge

act_cutscenes.title: ACT 0 · THE LAST PUZZLE OF DR. MARA SATO
act_cutscenes.location: Lake Geneva, Switzerland · Dr. Mara Sato’s Study

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Three weeks ago, legendary puzzle-maker Dr. Mara Sato passed away—leaving one final riddle tucked inside Sunday papers and public archives. Four hundred thousand people tried it, and your 2:14 AM answer earned a seat on Lake Geneva.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: I'm Julian Vance, Mara's longtime co-creator. Rather than hand her hundred-million-dollar Meridian Archive to a committee, she built an eight-city tournament—betting everything on one agile, curious mind.

lines.speaker: teo
lines.text: Relax, the Geneva warmup is the fun part. I'm Teo—audio engineer and official espresso smuggler. Mara built these first four questions just to see how you think—though... weird. Her private terminal just woke up the second you walked in.

act_cutscenes.title: ACT I · MARA’S MISSING CHAPTER
act_cutscenes.location: London, United Kingdom · The Sovereign Rotunda

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: Welcome to London. I'm Nadia Al-Mansoor. Mara Sato designed this rotunda with a glass floor so nothing stays buried—though the board seems awfully nervous about what's underneath.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: A charming warmup in Geneva, truly. Yet Mara's archive holds diplomatic secrets too delicate for chance. Join me in the corridor—let us speak like adults.

lines.speaker: teo
lines.text: Hey—while everyone was clinking champagne glasses, I checked the 2019 build logs. Mara ran a secret dress rehearsal seven years ago, and somebody scrubbed the winner's name.
lines.tts_text: Hey—while everyone was clinking champagne glasses, I checked the twenty nineteen build logs. Mara ran a secret dress rehearsal seven years ago, and somebody scrubbed the winner's name.

act_cutscenes.title: ACT II · ODDS IN THE NEON RAIN
act_cutscenes.location: Tokyo, Japan · The Horizon Sky Pavilion

lines.speaker: soren
lines.text: Seventy floors above Shibuya, friend—welcome to my neighborhood. I'm Soren Kael, card counter turned probability trader, and Mara invited me strictly to give the board heartburn.

lines.speaker: soren
lines.text: Word from London is you actually read the footnotes. Careful up here—half the trading floor already has side bets on whether your streak survives tonight.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Soren Kael counts cards faster than most people blink. Keep your cool, read his silver coin, and remember why Mara put you in that chair.

act_cutscenes.title: ACT III · TRIAL ZERO
act_cutscenes.location: Giza Plateau, Egypt · 38 Meters Below the Solar Hall

lines.speaker: teo
lines.text: Okay, deep breath—we're inside Mara's sealed Cairo vault. Trial Zero wasn't a test run. It was the first time someone beat Lindqvist's board fair and square.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: That handwriting in Mara's ledger... that's Tariq. My brother won her 2019 prototype—and the week he refused to sell out, the board made him vanish from the record.
lines.tts_text: That handwriting in Mara's ledger... that's Tariq. My brother won her twenty nineteen prototype—and the week he refused to sell out, the board made him vanish from the record.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Mara hid this room for seven years waiting for someone sharp enough to find it. Read the whole page before you judge me—Lindqvist's lawyers are already landing.

act_cutscenes.title: ACT IV · THE BOARD’S COUNTER-MOVE
act_cutscenes.location: Singapore · 90 Floors Above the Meridian Archive

lines.speaker: tariq
lines.text: Mara and Julian kept me off the grid in Reykjavik for seven winters so we could build a contest too public to rig. Now you carry her final key to the stage.

lines.speaker: lindqvist
lines.text: Enough charming detective work. Invoke Article Nine and seal the archive—Dr. Sato's whim will not hand global stewardship to an amateur.

lines.speaker: soren
lines.text: Plot twist, friend. Even a card shark knows when the house is dealing from the bottom of the deck. Consider my chips all-in on you.

act_cutscenes.title: ACT V · MARA’S FINAL TABLE
act_cutscenes.location: International Waters · Two Billion Live Witnesses

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: The Apex Forum. Two billion witnesses watching live, exactly as Mara drafted on a napkin seven years ago. No committees, no back rooms—just the questions.

lines.speaker: nadia
lines.text: For Tariq, for Mara, and for everyone who stayed up until two in the morning chasing a good clue. Beat Julian clean—in front of the whole world.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: Take the chair across from me, claim Mara's veto key, and decide what the sharpest mind on Earth leaves behind.
